$comment: Stage 6 control bands — see AI_NATIVE_SDLC.md and docs/DOCS_QUALITY.md. A band is a metric with a stable baseline, watched by scripts/control-bands.ts. Detection is deterministic; no model is involved in deciding a breach. Add a band only for a metric whose baseline is genuinely stable — a noisy metric produces noisy intents, and a watcher that cries wolf gets switched off, which is the failure this exists to prevent.
